source_pdf_title: GHG Protocol, IPCC Global Warming Potential Values, v2.0 (7 Aug 2024)
decision: Each LCIA method keeps its NATIVE GWP basis, as published and as shipped in the ecoinvent 3.11 method pack, so that background and foreground are characterised consistently within a method. ReCiPe 2016 v1.03 midpoint (H): IPCC AR5 GWP100 including climate-carbon feedbacks (CH4 non-fossil 34, CH4 fossil 36, N2O 298; Myhre et al. 2013, AR5 WG1 Table 8.7). EF 3.1: IPCC AR6 GWP100 (CH4 non-fossil 27.0, CH4 fossil 29.8, N2O 273; Forster et al. 2021, AR6 WG1 Table 7.15). Results under the two methods are therefore not directly comparable for N2O- and CH4-dominated systems; the report states which basis was used.

ReCiPe 2016 v1.03, midpoint (H).basis: IPCC AR5 GWP100 incl. climate-carbon feedbacks
